takes.title: Wander with Frequent Turns
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts mid-step, walks at an even pace with repeated changes of heading, and keeps walking through the final frame.

takes.sourceDescription: climb, step over, sit on, stand on stepstool
takes.title: Step Over, Sit Low, and Climb Up
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks and turns between several high steps and low seated holds, then rises and repeats. The CMU description identifies a stepstool.

takes.title: Wander and Change Heading Repeatedly
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks through alternating front, side, and back orientations, with occasional wider steps during turns. The last frame remains in stride.

takes.sourceDescription: wash windows, paint; hand signals; dance - Egyptian walk, the Dive, the Twist, the Cabbage Patch; boxing
takes.title: Move from Wiping and Signals into Dance and Boxing
takes.actionDescription: The performer moves through standing arm sweeps and signals, switches to bent-knee dance steps and turns, then finishes with the hands raised in a boxing stance.

segments.title: Standing arm sweeps and raised-hand motions

takes.sourceDescription: wash windows, paint; hand signals; dance - Egyptian walk, the Dive, the Twist, the Cabbage Patch; boxing
takes.title: Alternate Wiping, Dance, and Boxing Motions
takes.actionDescription: From standing, the performer alternates raised-arm reaches and pauses, then changes to rhythmic steps and rapid upper-body motions. The hands lower into a quiet standing finish.

segments.title: Small signals and high two-handed reaches
Stepping, bends, and turning arm motions

takes.title: Lean Forward for Repeated Two-Handed Reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer bends at the hips and extends both hands forward, resets upright between attempts, then makes a smaller one-handed reach. The take ends standing.

takes.title: Rise onto the Toes and Reach High
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates standing resets with raised-arm reaches and brief lifts onto the toes. The arms lower at the end.

takes.title: Circle the Forearms in Front of the Chest
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with forearms extended and repeatedly rotates them across the chest while staying in a narrow stance. The final pose keeps both elbows bent.

takes.title: Walk a Winding Route with Repeated Turns
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks continuously, reversing or changing heading several times while the arms swing low. They finish walking away.

takes.sourceDescription: sit on high stool, stand up
takes.title: Step into a High Sit and Rise Again
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks into a high seated position, rises and turns, then repeats the movement. The final pose is nearly upright in profile.

takes.sourceDescription: wash windows, paint figure eights; hand signals
takes.title: Trace High Wiping Arcs and Give Hand Signals
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, makes high and outward one-handed arcs, pauses, and continues with smaller hand signals. The CMU source identifies window washing and figure-eight painting motions.

takes.sourceDescription: wash windows; basketball - dribble, lay-up shot, pass; throw ball; dance - Egyptian walk, the Dive, the Twist; strew
takes.title: Shift from Arm Gestures into Sport and Dance Motions
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates face-level and high reaches before changing to quicker steps and turning arm motions. The CMU source describes window washing, basketball, and dance passages.

segments.title: Forward arm gestures and stepping turns
Low dip, rise, and side reach

takes.title: Mime Boxing with Stepping and Turns
takes.actionDescription: The performer brings both hands up, alternates short arm extensions with wider steps and turns, and lowers the arms while finishing in profile.

takes.title: Wander with Small Turns and an Upright Finish
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts walking, changes heading repeatedly with a low arm swing, and slows into a narrow upright stance at the end.
